# Villa24 Vlorë

> A small, quiet aparthotel in the centre of Vlorë, Albania. Four private rooms, each with its own bathroom and kitchenette, a free Lavazza coffee corner for guests, a few minutes on foot from the historic centre and a short walk from the sea.

Villa24 is a single-property, independently run aparthotel — not a chain or a booking platform. The website is one static page in English and Albanian; booking is by direct contact (email, phone, WhatsApp) or through Booking.com.

- Address: Rr. 7 Nëntori, Vlorë 9401, Albania (40.47158, 19.48668)
- Email: villa24vlore@gmail.com
- Phone / WhatsApp: +355 69 204 9179
- Check-in 14:30 · check-out 10:00
- 4 rooms · no pets · EUR

## Rooms

- [Superior Double or Twin — City View](https://villa24vlore.com/#prices): 2 guests, double or twin beds, kitchenette, balcony, city view.
- [Triple Room](https://villa24vlore.com/#prices): 3 guests, private bathroom, kitchenette. €5 more per night in season.
- [Large Double Room](https://villa24vlore.com/#prices): 2 guests, roughly 40 m², double bed, private bathroom.
- [Comfort Room with mini balcony](https://villa24vlore.com/#prices): 2 guests, double bed, mini balcony, private bathroom.

All four rooms have a private bathroom, kitchenette, air conditioning and free Wi-Fi. Three are double rooms with a sofa bed; one is a triple room with a sofa bed on request.

## Rates

- [Summer 2026 rates](https://villa24vlore.com/#prices): from €40/night in June, €45 in July, €55 in August, €35 in September. Prices are per night for 2 adults + 1 child; for 2 children, ask.
- Weekly and monthly long-stay rates are available on request.

## The property

- [About Villa24](https://villa24vlore.com/#about): the house, its location on Rruga "7 Nëntori" and the quiet central neighbourhood around it.
- [Photo gallery](https://villa24vlore.com/#gallery): the four rooms, the shared corridor and the Lavazza coffee corner.
- [Stay your way](https://villa24vlore.com/#stay): daily, weekly and monthly stays.

## Vlorë

- [Discover Vlora](https://villa24vlore.com/#discover): Flag Square and the Independence Monument, the Muradie Mosque, the Old Town, the National Museum of Independence, Kanina Castle and Kuzum Baba — all reachable from the property.

## Booking and contact

- [Contact and direct booking](https://villa24vlore.com/#contact): email villa24vlore@gmail.com or call +355 69 204 9179 for the best available rate.
- [Booking.com listing](https://www.booking.com/hotel/al/villa24-vlore.it.html)

## Legal

- [Privacy, Cookies & Terms](https://villa24vlore.com/legal.html) (EN/SQ): the site sets no cookies and uses no analytics or tracking; personal data reaches the owners only if a visitor chooses to send an email or WhatsApp message. Rates shown are indicative — a booking exists only once the owners confirm it in writing.

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://villa24vlore.com/sitemap.xml)
- WebMCP: the page registers browser-side agent tools on `navigator.modelContext` (property info, room list, rates, language switch, section navigation, and a booking-enquiry draft that is never sent automatically). Experimental API — absent in browsers that do not implement it.
- [Structured data](https://villa24vlore.com/): a schema.org LodgingBusiness JSON-LD block is embedded in the page head with the same address, rooms, amenities and rates.
